events.note: a point value, as five of the six lenses carry it

An absolute floor on clearance, independent of which objective is seated. It is the tightest working distance across the six (100x Oil, MRD71970), so it never binds while the lookup above is right, and it catches a lookup that has gone wrong -- a wrong key, a mis-seated nosepiece, a bad store value. Both limits are minima on clearance, so the LARGER of the two binds.
